_meta.title: Summer/Fall 2025 catalogs, style reference
_meta.source: La-Z-Boy Recliner, Motion, Stationary and Designer's Choice collection catalogs, Summer/Fall 2025 (Publitas flipbooks), read from their text layer. Built by scripts/build-catalog-2025-reference.py.
_meta.note: This is last season's printed catalog, not the app's 2026 data. A style here that is not in the 2026 style index may be discontinued, renamed or simply missing from the 2026 files. Confirm before offering it. Dimensions are as printed; some differ from 2026 (mostly power and wall-power widths).
